caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of quantifiers and operations across four reasoning categories. The chart is divided into a total of ten slices, representing different categories. The slices are colored in shades of green, blue, yellow, orange, and pink. Specifically, the slices represent "Existential" (green, 15.12%), "Quantifiers" (pink, 27.91%), "Limiter" (orange, 27.91%), "Negation" (yellow, 27.91%), "Universal Quantifiers" (blue, 29.07%), “Absolute” (yellow, 18.71%), “Absence” (orange, 18.71%), “Approximate Quantities” (green, 45.03%), "Comparative Relationships" (blue, 36.26%), and "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" (pink, 50.49%). The chart includes percentage labels within each slice, and a legend is not present.  The segments representing "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" and "Approximate Quantities" are visually offset from the center of the pie chart. The slices, with the exception of “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” appear to be ordered by decreasing size, moving clockwise.
